mechanism: Albendazole is extensively hepatically metabolized via CYP450 enzymes, and concurrent use with amoxicillin-clavulanate may alter albendazole levels through enzyme induction or competition; additionally, both drugs can cause gastrointestinal effects and hepatotoxicity.
action: Monitor liver function tests and clinical efficacy of albendazole; consider spacing administration and assessing for increased GI adverse effects; ensure adequate hepatic function before concurrent use.
